description: Verifies the structure-of-arrays ray bundles and their four-vector algebra: the lane-wise Minkowski product, the Lorentz factor, the relativistic velocity addition, and the evolution of an eight-lane Schwarzschild null bundle, without any dynamic allocation.

checks.label: the lane-wise Minkowski product follows -u0 v0 + u.v
the Lorentz factor equals 1 / sqrt(1 - beta^2) in every lane
the relativistic addition of 0.5 c and -0.5 c along x yields 0.8 c in the first lane and zero in the second
a new eight-lane bundle has all lanes active
every lane keeps a positive radius after the Schwarzschild evolution
no dynamic allocation occurs in the bundle algebra
